Red-first: pivot rows with a null first-dimension value → pre-fix the pin shows `{status: null, …}` emitted and the DOM drops the bar (capture); post-fix bucket-labeled, rendered, drill resolving. Must-not-change (green both sides): non-null pivot groups byte-identical; the single-dimension branch untouched (its #4498 pins stay green); empty result still the designed empty state.

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/core` + patch `@object-ui/plugin-charts` (reuses the existing option/constant — no new export expected; `.d.ts` measured both ways, minor only if surface grows). Never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts` + its tests, `packages/plugin-charts/**` tests (+ renderer only if measurement demands — report first), one changeset. ⛔ NOT: plugin-dashboard source (#4500 is its own pooled card), DashboardFilterBar (in-flight #4465), plugin-grid/plugin-list (in-flight #4501), console/** (in-flight #4467/#4475), the sweep file, content/docs/releases/.
